claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens.
MDG is one of the three tasks designed for seq2seq model pre-training, alongside Sentence Reordering and Next Sentence Generation.
The MDG task involves predicting the original text without the masked tokens, using a specific masking strategy.
